summary: Path/file-name helper (thiscall): builds a 1400-byte stack buffer whose first byte is copied from the global byte_5EA438 and whose remaining 1399 bytes are zeroed, then invokes a callback held at this + 0xC8 passing the buffer, its length 1400, and the argument stored at this + 0x100 so the callback populates the buffer. The populated buffer is then handed to sub_562710 which composes the final path into the output buffer buf. Called by the file-path name lookup path.

operations.description: Seed the stack buffer's first byte from byte_5EA438[0].
Zero the remaining 1399 bytes of the 1400-byte stack buffer via memset.
Call the indirect callback at this + 0xC8 with (buffer, 1400, *(this + 0x100)) to fill the buffer.
Delegate to sub_562710(buf, buffer) to compose the final path into the caller-supplied output buffer.
Called by FilePathNameLookup (0x005622C0) to resolve a path using the this-object's resolver callback.

unresolved: Meaning of global byte_5EA438 (its first byte seeds the buffer) is not established.
Purpose of the callback at this + 0xC8 and the argument at this + 0x100 depend on the owning object type.
What path composition sub_562710 performs is only known by name.
